verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs show a policy template library in two tiers (Formal and Comprehensive) that can be customized. They also describe a draft/publish flow where some drafts require review, which implies an approval step. Nothing documents versioning, per-employee acceptance tracking, or that the templates are lawyer-drafted. Missing for 10: policy version history, per-employee policy acceptance/attestation tracking, evidence of lawyer-grade template provenance, explicit editor and approval-workflow documentation, independent corroboration.
